title: Simple Changes kept queued worktrees
description: Record a closed Queue or Sweep run leaves beside the loop state at `queued-worktrees/<run-id>.json`: the worktrees it created and kept, each with the branch it was on. `loop start --mode queue|sweep` reads it to remove such a worktree once the target contains its work and every safety check passes; a worktree is never removed on this record alone. Kept in its own file so older runtimes never meet it, and deleted once none of its worktrees is left.
